Windows x64.

## Changes

Experimental live wallpaper support (alpha).

- Added MoeWalls browsing with source-specific filters, categories, sorting, and styling.
- Added animated wallpaper previews on hover and in wallpaper details.
- Added experimental live wallpapers with per-monitor playback.
- Added links to original wallpaper pages in the details window.
- Fixed automatic-update installation and release discovery.
- Removed the separate download-statistics helper from the repository.

## Download

Single EXE for Windows x64 with .NET 10 included.
